# Bundled service icons

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs from frontend/src/service-catalog.json and service-catalog.lock.json. Do not edit. -->

The 2585 SVGs in `frontend/public/service-icons/` identify services. 343 belong to the curated catalog in `frontend/src/service-catalog.json`, which also provides the service templates. The other 2242 form the extended tier: every remaining SVG icon of the pinned Dashboard Icons commit, named and categorized from its upstream `metadata.json` (blob `c5c1adc5816821420fc0fc5ba24d074ee927941d`). Extended logos are found through service recognition and the icon picker.

All files are checked by `scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs` and the frontend test suite: no scripts, event handlers, external references, embedded documents, animation or DTDs (embedded content is limited to base64 raster images), and at most 60 KB each. Downloaded files must match the git blob hash listed below. They are loaded as independent image documents; SVG IDs and styles therefore remain isolated. No icon CDN, external font, script, tracking asset or runtime download is used.

2583 icons are from [Dashboard Icons by Homarr Labs and contributors](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/blob/59f1e9a4108f4f510f41e9588f078631de1e1405), distributed under [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/blob/59f1e9a4108f4f510f41e9588f078631de1e1405/LICENSE). The complete license is included as `frontend/public/service-icons/LICENSE.txt`. The upstream distribution has no root NOTICE file. The 2582 files downloaded from the pinned commit were minified for distribution: comments, metadata, editor-specific markup and insignificant whitespace were removed; shapes, path data, colors and text are unchanged. The Navidrome SVG was vendored from an earlier commit and modified: Decorative rotation removed to keep the artwork static.

The Linkwarden SVG is from [selfh.st Icons by selfh.st and contributors](https://github.com/selfhst/icons/blob/b2378abb1a0c64149bb7621815b849d89602de23/svg/linkwarden.svg), distributed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://github.com/selfhst/icons/blob/b2378abb1a0c64149bb7621815b849d89602de23/LICENSE). Its complete license and warranty disclaimer are included as `frontend/public/service-icons/LICENSE-selfhst.txt`. No changes were made to this artwork.

The WebSSH SVG is from [WebSSH by bifrost0x and contributors](https://github.com/bifrost0x/webssh/blob/26257eba3a7c6691aedb42b7aa9874d2e3753392/static/images/webssh-logo.svg), distributed under [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/bifrost0x/webssh/blob/26257eba3a7c6691aedb42b7aa9874d2e3753392/LICENSE). The license text is identical to `frontend/public/service-icons/LICENSE.txt`. No changes were made to this artwork.

Product names, logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners. These icons identify the corresponding services and do not imply endorsement. Collection licenses do not grant trademark rights.

The runtime distribution includes a copy of these credits in `/service-icons/NOTICE.txt`, alongside the licenses.

To add a curated service, edit `frontend/src/service-catalog.json` and run `node scripts/sync-service-icons.mjs` from the repository root. The same command refreshes the extended tier.
